senses.gloss:
Aśoka
or azoka paNDita Bud. logician; teacher of Candragomin; q. Dharmottara an. hence flourished after 847 A. D.
--Avayavinirākaraṇa.
--Sāmānyadūṣaṇadikprasāritā.
Both ptd. in Haraprasad Sastri's edn. of Six Bud. Nyāya Tracts. Bib. Ind. 185.
See also JBORS. XXII. i. App. F. p. XIX.

Aśoka
or azokamuni Jain.
--Dānaśīlatapabhāvanākulaka or Dānādikulakācāra. BBRAS. 1843. Jainagranthāvalī p. 199. Peters. IV. Extr. p.. 122-23.

Aśokakathā
Jain. Fl. J. II. iv. 27.
See below Aśokacandrakathā an. Aśokacandrarohiṇīkathā.

Aśokakalpa
botany. Q. by Mallinātha on Meghasandeśa, 86.

Aśokakāntāmārīcīsādhana
Bud. Cordier II. p. 387. III. p.. 10. 43. 45. Nepal II. p. 267.
Pt.. Sādhanamālā, Pt. 1, GOS. XXVI. no. 141.

Aśokacandra_(?)
Jain.
--Jinastuti. BORI. 77 (10) of 1880-81. BORI. D. XIX. i. 221.

Aśokacandrakathā
Jain. Skt. Firenze 741. Fl. J. II. iii. 1; II. iv. 2.
See below under Aśokaroh2iṇīkathā. [Page433-a.

Aśokacandraguṇakīrtana
Jain. Śvet. Pkt. BORI. 77 (11) of 1880-81. BORI. D. XIX. ii. 705.

Aśokacaritrakathā
Jain. BP. p. 190a.

Aśokatrirātravrata
from Bhaviṣyottarapurāṇa. America 3452. BISM. v.. 363/22. CPB. 281. PUL. II. p. 160. Rajapur 525. Weber 1194 (7).
--from Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa. Hpr. IV. 21.

Aśokadattavyākaraṇa
Bud. AMG. II. p. 217. AR. XX. p. 410. J.. 1927 (Oct.-Dec.) p. 254 (A. datta. vyā.). Kanjur Kyoto 760 (32). Nanjio 23 (22) 42.

Aśokadanta
a. of the copper-plate inscription of King Bhūpendravarmadeva of Kaliṅga, recording the donation of a plot of land. See Epi. Ind. XXIII. p. 266.

Aśokadeśanā
Bud. Hpr. III. p. 5. Nepal II. p. 239.

Aśokapūjana
dh. pūjāvidhi attributed to Vyāsa. Udaipur I. B. 136. 395 (I).

Aśokamañjarī
jy. Oudh VII. 12.

Aśokamalla
son of King Vīrasiṁha. Q. Kīrtidhara, Abhinavagupta an. a little-known work named Sudhābdhi.
--Nṛtyādhyāya (?) Bik. 1098. Bikaner 3417.
Pt.. GOS. 141.
The ms. itself begins an. ends abruptly an. there is no clue to find the name of the bigger work of which this is only a chapter.

Aśokamallarāja
--Nighaṇṭusāra. med. Kāśin. 36.

Aśokamālikā
name of C. by Rāma Tarkavāgīśa on the Mugdhabodha Vyākaraṇa.

Aśokamukhanāgavijayapariccheda
Bud. Cordier III. p. 432. [Page433-b]

Aśokaraghunāthācārya
--Gopālaśataka. Adyar I. p. 190a.

Aśokarājaputracakṣurbhedanidānasūtra
Bud. on the blinding of Kuṇāla, son of Aśoka. Nanjio 1367.

Aśokarājāvadānasūtra
Bud. Nanjio 1344.

Aśokarohiṇīkathā
Jain. Chani 2785. Fl. J. II. iv. 27.
An Aśokacandrarohiṇīkathā (also called Rohiṇīparvakathā) by Muktivimala is published in Dayāvimala Jaina Granthamālā 17, Ahmedabad 1919.

Aśokavatīkathā
by Candanācārya, Śvetāmbara Jain. Mentioned by Soḍḍhala in his Udayasundarīkathā (C. 1026-1060 A. D.), GOS. XI. p. 155.

Aśokavanikāṅka
a. act of a Rāmāyaṇa drama like the Āścaryacūḍāmaṇi, popular in Malabar. Cherp 42. Krāṅgāṭ Mana 42.

Aśokavanikāṣṭaka
Trippūṇittura II. 291.

Aśokavratamāhātmya
Ānandāśrama 7875.

Aśokavratamāhātmyakathā
from Bhaviṣyottarapurāṇa. Dāhilakṣmī XXXV. 26.

Aśokaśrī
Bud.
--Kālayamārisādhana. Cordier II. p. 280.
--Piṇḍīkṛtahomavidhi. Cordier II. p. 279.
--Mañjuśrīcaryāmārgavidhi. ibid. p. 280.
--Mañjuśrīsādhana. ibid. p. 279. III. p. 70.
--Vajrabhairavasādhana. Cordier II. p. 280. III. p. 167.

Aśokānāman
from the Padmapurāṇa. America 1088.

Aśokāvadāna
Bud. Avadānas about Aśoka. Camb. Uni. Bud. p. 110 (Aśokāvadānamālā). [Page434-a. (See also ibid. p. 6). Hpr. III. p. 7. Nanjio 1459. Nepal II. p.. 174. 242 (Kunāla an. Vītaśoka Avadānas). RASB. I. 25. SBL. Nepal p.. 6-16 (Col. Ratnāvadānamālā).
Pt.. (1) in Divyāvadāna in Roman script ed. by E. B. Cowell an. R. A. Neil, Cambridge, 1886. (2) in Divyāvadāna p.. 216-282. in Devanāgarī script, Bud. Skt. Texts 20, Mithila Institute of Post-graduate Studies an. Sanskrit Learning. Darbhanga, 1959. (3) with critical intro. an. textual notes etc. by Sujitkumar Mukhopadhyaya, Sahitya Akademi, New Delhi, 1963.
First Chinese transl. by Fa-chin C. 300 A. D. For its French transl. an. comparative study of the Indian an. Chinese versions see Przyluski, Paris, 1923.
A different recension translated into Chinese by a Śramaṇa of Funan in 512 A. D.

Aśokāvadāna
Bud. by Jayaśrī. AS. p. 244.

Aśokāṣṭamīvidhi
Ani.

Aśokāṣṭamīvrata
CPB. 282. IM. 6630.

Aśocyādhikāra
Jain. JASB. 1908, p. 409a (no. 6992).

Asoḍha
guru of Soḍhala (a. of Guṇasaṅgraha). CPB. 1236. Kh. 7.
